content:
Welcome to the game, I'm happy to hear you've already found some fave characters!!

May I ask what chapter you're up to in the story?

There are many team comps you can use and this varies greatly by player preference too! Personally I suggest having a main team (featuring your faves and general combat), a dps "glass canon" team, a flawless shield team (prioritizing survivability), a counter team (against multi-hit enemies and reinforce), a poison team and a death res team! This would ensure you have enough teams for dzone too 

From the sounds of trying to minimize revives, it sounds like a flawless and death res teams would be beneficial for you right now! (or adding extra suriviability to your Saya + Caraboo combo)

Aequor is a fantastic choice for flawless as the tentacles give a massive shield boost while the raging stance let's you choose when to attack! Sanga scales damage on shield amount while removing the fragile debuff, Corposant gives additional shielding and can be used as a main dps too, when built for it.  

Pretty much anyone can be added to Saya + Caraboo, a main/secondary dps with a high shield warden would be wise! You can build Caraboo as your main or secondary dps with the right wods, stats and enlighten, as snowy hex has high damage!

Sorry my reply is getting long; so here's some example teams I'd put together (it's not set in stone and varies by player so please change to your liking!!), where there's more than 4 characters, pick whoever you like most or wasn't used for another team

Good luck and hope this helps!!💖  (sorry I didn't include further reasoning or this would be a novel omg... But happy to answer further questions!)

content:
Congrats on making it to arc2!! Each astral chapter has it's own unique gimmicks and some favor different realm/strategies over others. Chapter 1 is pretty straightforward but ch2 and ch3 is usually what trips up new players and require stronger, more intentional teambuilding!

That's a good mindset for revives, both for trying not to rely on them but also not letting them go to waste (this becomes more important for hard difficulty for extra silver rewards)

Of course, happy to help! Many players prefer pure pcaro due to the strong buffs, paired with many favorite characters in the realm, it's super viable as long as you manage health and boost survival! <3

It's definitely an ongoing learning process of getting familiar with characters and the different ways to play them, there's many possibilities and options! A delightful perk of this game is there isn't a definitive "correct" way to play, so don't be afraid to see what works best for you or which characters you like most<:Ogier_cheer:1468259351889318049>
